title: Spectral Bounds for Tensors Derived from Trace Functionals and Wasserstein Distance in Tensor Spaces
summary: This article introduces a trace-based metric on the space of positive semi-definite (PSD) tensors, offering a geometric perspective that connects their algebraic structure to their intrinsic geometric properties. It defines the Bures-Wasserstein distance on tensor spaces, establishing clear measurements between tensors. Moreover, the study derives trace-based eigenvalue bounds for PSD tensors and analyzes how these bounds depend on the PSD condition.
